result.reason: The revision meets the fallback by preserving affiliate coverage and permitting transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction, while also adding the preferred contractor-use right. It does not achieve the preferred perpetual/irrevocable or subscription-termination protections, but those are not required by the stated fallback. The edits are targeted and preserve the location, fee, exclusivity, software-format, and documentation limitations. Drafting is professional, though “their behalf” could be made slightly clearer by expressly referring to Sparkling and its affiliates.
